messages:
Alex K: Heads-up — Customer 'BlueFin' wants a 4-week POC: streaming summarization + relevance rerank, on-prem VPC, BYO-KMS, 200ms median latency SLA. Maria, can you confirm success criteria we promised?
Maria (Sales): Timeline is tight. They want security questionnaire back by Mon and a pricing estimate for Dedicated + private infra. I'm drafting the SOW but need perf/ops numbers.
Raj (ML Eng): For 200ms median with rerank+streaming we'll likely need a smaller quantized model or aggressive caching. Candidate models: redwood/llama3-8k-4bit or a tuned 7B quant. We should run a 1k-query eval set (accuracy + latency) and measure 95p. Prefix/KV caching will help a lot.
Jen SRE: On-prem changes: we need to remove egress, integrate their KMS (HSM) for keys, and forward audit logs to their SIEM. That adds infra work: private control plane setup + log forwarding + HSM config. Estimate 2–3 days setup and some one-time wiring. Blockers: KMS compatibility, IP allowlist, and storage for KV cache.
Maria (Sales): Can you give a rough delta to the price so I can update SOW? They asked for an apples-to-apples number today.
Alex K: Need a ballpark now — rough monthly + one-time. Also list the must-have blockers.
Jen SRE: Ballpark: Dedicated cluster + private control plane ~ $12k/mo baseline. One-time setup & HSM integration ~ $18k (network + HSM certs + SIEM). If we need a special connector for their KMS, add engineering hours. Must-haves to unblock: KMS vendor + cert, firewall IP allowlist, SIEM endpoint, expected QPS.
Raj (ML Eng): Quality note: 4-bit quantization may slightly affect rerank precision. We'll run an A/B on the eval harness and measure MRR/NDCG. I can drop a prompt/eval set by EOD tomorrow. Also recommend testing both batch rerank (lower cost) and online streaming rerank (lower latency) — hybrid might be best.
Maria (Sales): Please add the eval script and a sample load test command I can pass to the customer's infra team.
Raj (ML Eng): Quick perf command (dev): `./loadtest --target-latency=200ms --qps=20 --model=redwood/llama3-8k-4bit --prompt-set=bluefin-1000.json`
DeployBot: Canary deployment scheduled for 2026-04-02 03:00 UTC for dedicated pool d-44 (FYI).
Alex K: @Raj can you own the eval and @Jen own infra checklist? I'll take SOW and quoting. I'll need a short bulleted blocker list from each.
Jen SRE: I can own infra. Maria — please get the customer's network/KMS contact and SIEM endpoint. I'll produce a checklist and a preliminary runbook (NAT/firewall rules, certs, KMS test vector).
Maria (Sales): Will do. Action items: 1) Raj — eval + prompt set by EOD Wed; 2) Jen — infra estimate & checklist by tomorrow; 3) Alex — draft SOW & updated quote tomorrow morning. Everyone okay?
Raj (ML Eng): OK. One more: we should include a note in the SOW that quantized model is experimental for rerank accuracy; offer fallback to unquantized model in Dedicated for a higher price.
Alex K: Good call. I'll add fallback + canary rollout plan to SOW. Closing this thread — I'll circulate the quote and SOW update tomorrow. :thumbsup:
